senses.gloss: f. (חרס; cmp. הַרְסָנָא) a pap made of fruits and spices with wine or vinegar, used for sweetening the bitter herb on the Passover night.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 116a:4">Ib. 116ᵃ</cite> (play on <cite ref="H01724"><he>חֶרֶס</he> I</cite>) <he>ח׳ זכר לטיט</he>, v. <cite ref="G00469"><he>זֵכֶר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 10:9">Tosef. ib. X, 9</cite>; a. e.
